issues.title: Incorrect revenue calculation
issues.problem: Revenue should only include transactions with status 'COMPLETED', but all transactions are summed.

issues.title: Implicit join syntax
issues.problem: Implicit join syntax is less readable and more prone to errors than explicit JOIN syntax.
issues.fix: FROM fact_transactions t JOIN dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id

issues.title: Lack of comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining the logic, which can be helpful for future maintenance.
issues.fix: Add comments to explain the purpose of each clause.

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED') as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as txn_count FROM fact_transactions t JOIN dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE t.transaction_date > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY m.merchant_name ORDER BY total_revenue LIMIT 10;
review.summary: The query has a critical correctness issue with revenue calculation and a readability issue with implicit join syntax. Adding comments would improve maintainability.
